item.coloph: tshag chung la don che ba'i man ngag 'di/ mkha' 'gro nyi ma 'od ldan 'bar mas/ gnas mchog phug leb stag rtse ru/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor bdag la snyan du brgyud/ bdag gis sbas dang gsang rgya thub par byas/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyong srung ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge bas 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
